Example 2


Declan is entitled to the highest rate of the care component and the higher rate of the mobility
component of DLA. He turns 16 on 17.9.16 and is invited to claim PIP. On 30.9.16 Declan makes a claim to
PIP. He is subsequently taken into hospital on 5.10.16. Although he is now a hospital in-patient, Declan’s
PIP claim continues. A decision is made on his PIP claim that his DLA will terminate on 23.11.16 and he
will be entitled to the enhanced rate of the daily living component and the enhanced rate of the mobility
component of PIP from 24.11.16 – 23.11.19. He is paid DLA up to 23.11.16 and payment of PIP from
24.11.16 will continue whilst he remains in hospital as he was under the age of 18 when he was admitted
to hospital on 5.10.16 (see ADM Chapter P3 for PIP hospitalisation rules).


P5022 When a DLA entitled claimant, who after 27.10.13, has neither


1. been sent an invitation to claim PIP 1nor


2. made a claim for PIP2


sends in a change of circumstances notification3, the Secretary of State will send the claimant an
invitation to claim PIP as soon as reasonably practicable (see P5035 and P5071).


Note 1: This does not include those persons who inform the DM that they are to be absent or have

become absent from GB, whether on a temporary or permanent basis 4.


Note 2: This does not apply where ADM P5021 applies.


                                                         1 PIP (TP) Reg, reg 3(1); 2 reg 4; 3 reg 3(5); 4 reg 3(6)

P5023 However, P5022 will only apply where


1. the Secretary of State has specified a relevant date which applies to that DLA entitled person and


2. the DLA entitled person reports the change of circumstances on or after the relevant date 1.


Note: If the DLA entitled person has not been given a relevant date, then the change of circumstances
should be taken into account for any DLA supersession action required.


                                                                                1 PIP (TP) Regs, reg 3(5A)

Check governing headings, definitions, exceptions and current source.","text":"Determination of claim for PIP made

P5062 When an assessment determination is made by the DM on a claim by a transfer claimant


1. the DM will, as soon as is practicable, send the claimant written notification of the outcome decision
and


2. DLA will be terminated, on the last day of the period of 28 days starting with the first pay day after the

making of the determination1.


                                                                                     1 PIP (TP) Regs, reg 17(1)


P5063 When the outcome decision is an award of either or both PIP components, the claimant’s
entitlement to PIP will begin


1. from the day immediately following the day the claimant’s entitlement to DLA terminates 1 or


2. immediately following the last day of the period of 28 days as calculated in P5035 starting with the
first pay day after making the determination.


                                                                                     1 PIP (TP) Regs, reg 17(2)


P5064 The notifications issued must contain the information1 if


1. PIP is awarded, the day on which

      1.1 the claimant’s entitlement to DLA will terminate and


      1.2 the claimant’s entitlement to PIP will start


2. DLA is not awardedand a claim for PIP was made after the refusal 2


      2.1 where PIP is awarded, DLA will terminate on the day before the day the claimant becomes
      entitled to PIP or


      2.2 where PIP is not awarded, DLA will terminate on the first pay day following the period of 28

      days after the PIP assessment decision is made3.


                                                               1 PIP (TP) Regs, reg 17(3); 2 reg 17(4); 3 reg 17(5)

P1011 The main qualifying conditions to PIP are


1. age1 (see P1013) and


2. habitual residency, presence and competency2 (see ADM Chapter C2) and


3. the claimant is not entitled to ADP, CDP or PADP3 and


4. meeting the relevant threshold4 for entitlement under the daily living and/or mobility component
activities and


5. the required period condition5.


Although there is no formal order of consideration of these conditions, if any of the first three are not
satisfied, then the fourth and fifth need not be considered.


                 1 WR Act 12, s 83(1); 2 s 77(3); 3 s 77(4); 4 SS (PIP) Regs, reg 4; 5 SS (PIP) Regs, reg 12 & 13
